item.title: Welcome - Setup Required
item.description:
This feed will populate once you run the GitHub Action.

Steps:

  1. Go to Actions tab in your repository
  2. Enable workflows if prompted
  3. Run "Update Job Postings" workflow
  4. Wait 2-3 minutes
  5. Refresh your RSS reader

See PHONE_SETUP.md for details.
